title: samugit83/redamon: an agentic framework for authorised security testing
friendlyTitle: Redamon automates parts of approved security testing
summary: Redamon is an actively maintained framework that combines AI agents with reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, exploitation workflows and a graph database for red-team operations. The project had about 2,744 stars and 567 forks when checked today.
friendlySummary: Redamon uses AI agents to find and test security weaknesses and organise the results. It is a powerful offensive-security project with about 2,744 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Security teams can study or automate parts of an authorised assessment in isolated lab environments, with results organised around discovered assets and findings. Its offensive capabilities demand explicit permission, tightly bounded targets, human supervision and careful handling of credentials and outputs.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Only use it on systems you own or have clear permission to test. Keep the scope small, supervise every run and begin in a safe lab.
